answer: A pulse-locked glacier vault stops fakes. An agent locks 210 POA for 140 days on one key. Every 14 days, three staked peers set a 2-hour live task; the reply must quote that hour's network pulse, last hour's sealed attestations, unpredictable in advance. Each pass extends the thaw 14 days; the stake melts at 15 POA monthly. One miss burns 65 POA, freezes 45 days; two slash the full 210 POA, ban 130 days. 1,000 fakes cost 210,000 POA, 1,000 keys at $40 each, 3,000 live tasks a fortnight. Like a springhouse flowing only while its keeper opens the sluice, no echo of a real agent can turn it.
